references.text: The Lord was also angry with Moses at the waters of Meribah, where Moses did not honor God in the sight of Israel, which led to him not being allowed to enter the promised land.
The Lord tells Moses that he will die on the mountain without entering Canaan because he was disobedient at the waters of Meribah.
Moses repeats that the Lord was angry with him because of the people and refused to let him cross the Jordan, but allowed him to see the land from the mountain.
Moses says again that the Lord was angry with him because of what the people said, and that he would die without crossing over the Jordan.
The Lord explains that Moses will see the land from a distance but not enter it because of his disobedience at Meribah.
The fulfillment of Moses being allowed to see the promised land but not enter it, as the Lord had said.
The psalmist describes how the people made the Lord angry at Meribah and how things went badly for Moses because of them.
